description_en: Queries lifecycle hooks. When you call this operation, you can specify the lifecycle hook ID or scaling group ID to query the details of the desired lifecycle hook, such as the default action after the lifecycle hook times out, scaling activity that corresponds to the lifecycle hook, Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the notification recipient, and effective period of the lifecycle hook
description_zh: 调用DescribeLifecycleHooks通过指定生命周期挂钩ID或伸缩组ID来查询生命周期挂钩的信息，包括等待状态结束后的下一步动作、生命周期挂钩对应的伸缩活动类型、通知对象标识符、挂起等待时间等
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-lifecycle-hooks --scaling-group-id asg-bp1igpak5ft1flyp0000 --lifecycle-hook-name lifecyclehook0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --lifecycle-hook-ids ash-bp1at9ufhmcf9cmy0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLifecycleHooks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the lifecycle hook
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值：50。

默认值：50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the lifecycle hooks that you want to query
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_ids

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id
